feedback.samjho: Action-reaction pairs (Newton's 3rd law) are equal and opposite but act on different objects. So, they don't cancel. For example, when you push a wall, the wall pushes back with equal force. Your motion depends on net force (unbalanced forces), not the reaction pair. Formula: F = ma (Newton's 2nd law). Practice: If a 10 kg object accelerates at 2 m/s², what's the net force?
